geometry.geometry_scope: complete original axis-aligned pillar union plus explicitly extended closed ground slab
geometry.ground_adaptation: source finite open sheet extended to a closed slab; physical ground convention retained only in declared logical XY domain and z>=0
geometry.ground_union_semantics: pillar bottom faces are removed; occupied-side distances measure exposed union boundary, not raw internal faces
geometry.boundary_construction: axis-aligned face rectangle subtraction; no voxel approximation; T-junction-conforming centre-fan triangulation
geometry.oracle: float64 distance to exposed rectangles; union occupancy sign; independent of SdfLib and triangulation
geometry.t_junctions: rectangle edges split at every coincident axis-line corner before triangulation

source_adaptation.change: Cache raw Hermite entries as before; on a cache miss query a separate persistent tmd BVH and stably recompute distance/gradient on its selected triangle instead of TriangleUtils region classification or tmd expanded quadratic residuals.
source_adaptation.process_contract: Exactly one immutable mesh and one octree construction per exporter process; run with --threads 1.
source_adaptation.mutex: Cache access and raw sample creation are protected; more than one thread can still change which sample wins, and this does not repair upstream statistics races.
preserved: tricubic coefficient construction and query evaluation
raw-node sharing and zero mixed Hermite derivatives
limits: The representative gradient at a medial tie remains arbitrary.
This is not a prescribed smoothing width, a conservative SDF, or a global error guarantee.
Repeated logical nodes near a key rounding boundary can still receive different keys; use an aligned dyadic grid and check seams at the actual world-coordinate scale.
The collision guard prevents merging adjacent logical nodes only under the declared sampling lattice spacing; it cannot infer a wrong maxDepth or step.
Sharing raw Hermite inputs does not prove all adaptive coarse/fine interfaces continuous; rerun full seam checks.
Signed-distance semantics require the same closed consistently oriented mesh assumptions as tmd; this does not repair invalid geometry.
Zero-distance and medial-tie gradient representatives are not unique and do not prove global C1 continuity.
Double evaluation still queries float32-stored geometry and is not an exact arithmetic or global interpolation error certificate.

The global nearest face is still selected by the bundled tmd BVH and its distance routine. The stable selected-triangle recomputation cannot certify that selection globally; test near-zero and competing-face cases independently.
source_adaptation.coordinate_scope: World-coordinate full-map or ROI dyadic grids; actual bounds and depths are recorded by each exporter JSON, not fixed by this patch.
source_adaptation.grid_contract: Set step to the finest raw sampling lattice spacing (half the finest cell). Distinct logical sampling nodes must be at least one step apart on some axis. Same-key points differing by step/4 or more on any axis throw instead of merging.
source_adaptation.raw_value_method: Full tmd BVH selects a face on the immutable float32 mesh promoted to double. Recompute that triangle's closest point from its inside-plane projection and three clamped edge segments, using direct squared residuals. Ignore tmd distance magnitude/nearest_point and the supplied nearestTriangleIndex.
source_adaptation.raw_sign_method: Strict selected-face interior: signbit(dot(point-a, oriented unit normal)). Edge/vertex projection: retain signbit(tmd signed distance), including negative zero.
source_adaptation.raw_gradient_method: For nonzero recomputed distance, (point-recomputed_closest_point)/signed_norm. Numerical zero uses the selected triangle's oriented unit normal as a shared representative. Mixed Hermite derivatives remain zero.
source_adaptation.raw_zero_tolerance: 64 * double epsilon * max(norm(point), norm(each triangle vertex), each edge length); no float-scale or fixed-metre snapping.
source_adaptation.raw_primitive_license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 Jose Antonio Fernandez Fernandez; original licensed header is retained in this source copy.
source_adaptation.construction_cost: An additional CPU BVH is built once per exporter process. Upstream nearest-face queries still run; this adaptation accepts duplicate search work to isolate raw-value correctness.
